run_f_gold: run f_gold to convert a sentence to Google Case with lowercase first letters and uppercase rest
test_f_gold: test f_gold against sample inputs to verify Google Case transformation correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use Python string methods instead of manual character iteration
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like empty strings or single character inputs
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which transforms each word to have a lowercase first letter and uppercase remaining letters
